style: Parent-selected C: layered cut-paper, tactile fibers, shallow shadows, colored-pencil warmth.

reference.role: Style reference only; first-version asset retained in Git history.

composition: Backgrounds are original environmental illustrations. The consistent character and all meaningful moving objects/effects are controlled separately. Pond has no baked-in water and snow has no baked-in mitten to avoid frozen duplicate interaction targets.

assets.promptBrief: Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut picture-book meadow beside a low foreground pond; no text, people, mascot, sun, cloud or vapor. Then edit only the foreground water into smooth dry sandy ground so the real animated water surface can be drawn separately, preserving scenery and composition.

Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut sky above a mountain valley. Ivory layered cloud banks frame outer edges, generous blue center for an interactive cloud and tiny water drops. No text, faces, visible water vapor or rain.

Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut gentle overcast forest clearing, round tree canopies, low stream and closed flower buds, empty central sky for interactive cloud and rain. No labels, baked-in rain or mascot.

Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut snowy mountain meadow, snow-covered pines, open central sky, snowy clearing and sunlit stone. Then remove the foreground red mitten only, preserving the landscape, for a separately controlled mitten and snow.

Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut scene high beside a towering gentle slate-blue/lavender thundercloud. Sculptural cloud banks frame the edges with open center for controlled ice, water drops and wind effects. No arrows, cross-section diagram, hail, lightning, labels or mascot.

Full-bleed 16:9 paper-cut low aerial green valley with broad winding turquoise stream and still foreground pool, open sandy bank with plants, a leaf and rounded hills. Distinct real river, soil and pool areas for touch interaction. No arrows, labels or mascot.
